title: Ola Electric Q2 FY27 (Jul-Sep 2026, results reported 12 Nov 2026): revenue from operations ₹421 crore, down 39% from ₹690 crore and 7% from ₹455 crore in Q1; loss ₹362 crore, 13% narrower than ₹418 crore a year earlier but 8% wider than ₹336 crore in Q1 (about ₹86 lost per ₹100 of revenue, idly's sum); rival Ather's Q2 FY27 revenue ₹1,464 crore (+63%), profit ₹1.26 crore after a ₹154 crore loss (Ola is 29% of Ather, idly's sum); October 2026 Vahan: Ola fifth with 12,096 e-2W registrations (5.4%) behind TVS 60,429, Bajaj 49,067, Ather 31,796, Hero Vida 29,901; ~₹1,000 crore rights issue allotted after the quarter
